bug: Addition overflow detection checks the next-to-sign bit of the result in the positive-plus-positive case.
trigger: With DATA_WIDTH=8, start an addition of 0x40 and 0x40 and keep i_enable asserted through LOAD, COMPUTE, and OUTPUT. The correct sum is 0x80 with signed overflow, but the mutant checks result[6] instead of result[7].
effect: o_resultant_sum is still 0x80, but o_overflow is incorrectly 0.
